title: Syndicate Kind
description: What kind of syndicate serves inference: who owns the harness, who owns authentication, and how much of the control plane the agency holds (plan.101526.syndicate.md). Displayed as '<kind> syndicate'.

display.description: Label used everywhere a syndicate is shown, e.g. 'rogue syndicate'

harness_owner.description: vendor: the vendor's harness runs the tool loop; agency: the nim harness does

auth_owner.description: vendor: the vendor's sign-in or key; agency: none, or a vaulted credential

control_plane.description: full: the agency controls host, process, and shell; limited: only what the vendor's harness exposes

vendor_required.description: Whether a syndicate of this kind must name a vendor
